title: DOCSIS: DOCSIS 4.0 modifications and additions
description:
Each commit stands on its own, but I opted for a big MR to avoid merge issues (all commits change the same file).
Let me know if splitting them up is still preferred.

The non-trivial changes may be simple, but imply debatable choices were made.
Naturally, all other changes are debatable as well.

# References

- References come from [CM-SP-MULPIv4.0-I08-231211](https://www.cablelabs.com/specifications/CM-SP-MULPIv4.0).
- SEC-prefixed references come from [CM-SP-SECv4.0-I06-230503](https://www.cablelabs.com/specifications/CM-SP-SECv4.0).

# Non-trivial changes

- *CMTS Major/Minor DOCSIS Version* have been renamed to *Pre-DOCSIS 4.0* in CM-SP-MULPIv4.0,
  and two new TLVs have been added reusing the old names.

  To avoid confusion, the field filters are now named `docsis_mdd.docsis_version.*`.
  The old field filter names are kept, but hidden, for backwards compatibility.
  They now contain the actual DOCSIS major/minor version which is
  `docsis_mdd.docsis_version.major` if present, and `docsis_mdd.docsis_version.major_pre_40` if not
  (same for minor).
- `docsis_mdd.type` and `docsis_mdd.length` are replaced with
  `docsis_mdd.tlv.type` and `docsis_mdd.tlv.length` for clarity and consistency.
- `docsis_mdd.unknown_tlv` and `docsis_mdd.cmts_docsis_version_unknown` had the wrong type
  and are removed (no added value).
  The heading item for each TLV tree now represents `docsis_mdd.tlv` (instead of a `text`).
- *Advanced Band Plan Descriptor* replaced *Full Duplex Descriptor*
  and its sub-TLVs from CM-SP-MULPIv4.0-I01 to CM-SP-MULPIv4.0-I02.
  This translates to the removal of `docsis_mdd.full_duplex_descriptor`,
  and the addition of `docsis_mdd.advanced_band_plan`.
  CM-SP-MULPIv4.0-I08 also dropped sub-TLVs 22.1 and 22.4.1, 22.4.2.
- `docsis_optrsp.tlv_data` and `docsis_optrsp.rxmer_snr_margin.tlv_data`
  clutter the GUI and are counter-intuitive.
  Instead, `docsis_optrsp.tlv` and `docsis_optrsp.rxmer_snr_margin.tlv` are available
  to loop through (consistent with other TLVs).
- `docsis_optrsp.rxmer_snr_margin.threshold_per_subc` is a bit-field with dynamic length, > 64 bits.
  Given its limited use, it's implemented as `FT_BYTES` for now.
- `docsis_bpkm.attr` covers all attributes
  while `docsis_bpkm.attr.type` and `docsis_bpkm.attr.length` reflected individual TLVs.
  `docsis_bpkm.attr.tlv` was added with `docsis_bpkm.attr.tlv.type` and `docsis_bpkm.attr.tlv.length`.

# Bug fixes

- MDD DOCSIS Version TLV loop didn't respect declared length.
- BPKM attributes would miss one byte by using "-1" for a text item instead of the known length.
- UCD Subcarrier 0 center frequency had wrong type.

# Other changes

- Reduction custom `true_false_string` in Probe MAP.
- MDD DS ACL Primary Capable field (Table 41) no longer lists FDX (in favor of explicit FDX Downstream field).
- Use `units_hz` and `units_mhz`
